No power cord, plug, interior cavity, or display panel close-up visible to confirm function.
No visible grill element, rack, or grill-specific markings despite the seller's claim of 'grill' function.
No shot of the unit powered on, display lit, or turntable rotating.

Close-up of grill element or grill mode being used with visible heating.

response.reason: Item is clearly identifiable by type as a used microwave claiming a grill function, but no working proof, grill proof, or interior condition is shown, so it must be priced at worst case against comparable used microwaves in the same market.
